title: Run-IQ fact disclosure
description: A disclosure of some facts of a decision input, and proofs that some pointers are absent from it (run-iq.disclosure/1), as discloseFacts from @run-iq/spec writes it and verifyFactDisclosure reads it. A fact shows every leaf of the salted input tree at or below its pointer, each with its index among the leaves sorted by decoded JSON pointer segments and its RFC 6962 audit path, framed by neighbour leaves; a neighbour shows only its pointer, its salt and the commitment C to its content (its kind, value and valueSalt stay hidden; its pointer is shown, so keys that are themselves private should be opaque). Checks NOT expressible in JSON Schema, made only by verifyFactDisclosure: each audit path holds exactly the hashes of the audit path of its leaf (index below size, path length that of (index, size)); not more facts, nor more leaves in a fact, than leaves (size); each leaf names a place where a valid input has a leaf, its kind and value fit that place (as inputLeafHash checks it); no pointer holds a lone UTF-16 surrogate; facts and absences by increasing pointer, each once, no fact inside another; inputDigest is the digest verified against; each leaf is in that tree at its index; each fact shown whole (its leaves at consecutive indices, each at or below its pointer, its lists holding every element, framed by exactly the neighbours it needs: before unless its first leaf is at its pointer or first in the tree, after unless it is a scalar, an empty object or an empty list, or its last leaf is last in the tree, neither inside it); each absence framed by its neighbour leaves (adjacent, the second not inside the pointer; the first leaf alone before it, the last alone after it; none only in the empty tree); the leaves contradict neither each other nor an absence. Every conclusion assumes a tree sorted honestly by its signer: only a replay with the input checks it.

size.description: The number of leaves of the input tree, which the input digest commits to.

absent.description: The proven absences, by increasing pointer.

leaves.description: Every leaf at or below the pointer, by increasing index.

neighbourLeaf.description: A leaf shown without its content: its pointer, salt and commitment C.
